# secobserve_api_configuration (Resource)

A per-product configuration for importing observations from a scanner's API (as opposed to uploading a scan result file).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "secobserve_parser" "trivy" {
  name = "Trivy Operator Prometheus"
}

resource "secobserve_api_configuration" "trivy_import" {
  product  = secobserve_product.checkout.id
  name     = "Trivy scan import"
  parser   = data.secobserve_parser.trivy.id
  base_url = "https://trivy.example.com"
  api_key  = var.trivy_api_key

  automatic_import_enabled = true
  automatic_import_branch  = secobserve_branch.main.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `base_url` (String) Base URL of the scanner's API.
- `name` (String) Name of the configuration. Unique per product.
- `parser` (Number) Id of the parser to use. Use the `secobserve_parser` data source, filtered to `source = "API"`, to resolve a parser name.
- `product` (Number) Id of the product this configuration imports into. Immutable: SecObserve rejects moving a configuration to a different product, so a change replaces it.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) API key for the scanner. Encrypted at rest; SecObserve strips it from responses unless the caller can edit the configuration, which a superuser token always can.
- `automatic_import_branch` (Number) Id of the branch new observations are imported into. Must belong to `product`; SecObserve rejects one that does not with a 400.
- `automatic_import_docker_image_name_tag` (String) "<image name>:<tag>" to associate imported observations with.
- `automatic_import_enabled` (Boolean) Whether SecObserve imports from this configuration on its own schedule.
- `automatic_import_endpoint_url` (String) Endpoint URL to associate imported observations with.
- `automatic_import_kubernetes_cluster` (String) Kubernetes cluster name to associate imported observations with.
- `automatic_import_service` (Number) Id of the service new observations are attributed to.
- `basic_auth_enabled` (Boolean) Whether to authenticate with HTTP Basic auth in addition to `api_key`.
- `basic_auth_password` (String, Sensitive) HTTP Basic auth password. Encrypted at rest and, unlike `api_key`, never stripped from a response.
- `basic_auth_username` (String) HTTP Basic auth username.
- `project_key` (String) Project key or identifier within the scanner, if it needs one.
- `query` (String) Query used to select results, for scanners that need one (for example a Prometheus query for the Trivy Operator).
- `test_connection` (Boolean, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) When `true`, SecObserve performs a live connection check against the scanner using the rest of this configuration as part of the apply, and fails the whole request if it does not succeed.

~> This is a side-effecting action, not stored state: it never appears in a read and cannot cause drift. Set it in an `ephemeral` or pass it via `-var` on the applies where a live check is actually wanted, rather than leaving it `true` in committed configuration -- every apply would re-run the check.
- `verify_ssl` (Boolean) Whether to verify the scanner's TLS certificate.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric id of the configuration.
